title: console: a permitted editor gets no Edit / Delete on controlled_by_parent records — the record header hides them although security/explain answers allowed and the PATCH returns 200 (HotCRM sales manager on contracts and quotes, 17.7.0)
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with reach measured**: a permitted editor is offered no Edit or Delete on `controlled_by_parent` records in the console. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat, `session_012zh91QzFgePbkmuHnugLN3`, from the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, finding B-01).

**Who acts on it:** platform triage, then the console / record-header owner. The app side has nothing to change: its grants are correct, and the server enforces them as written.

## Reach (measured 2026-10-10)

HotCRM `main` `1d7148bf` on `@objectstack/*` **17.7.0**, booted with `pnpm dev`, then `pnpm demo:staff`, in Chromium 141.

- Logged in as `sales.manager@objectos.ai` (position `sales_manager`), open contract **CTR-0005**, owned by another user (`/_console/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_contract/record/IhGHc1olTmrNDHJP`). The record header has **no Edit**; the "…" menu holds only **Share**. Quote **QTE-0005** (`crm_quote`) shows the same.
- The server says the manager may edit:
  - the page's own `POST /api/v1/security/explain {object: crm_contract, operation: update}` → `{"allowed": true}`;
  - for `crm_quote`, update and delete are both allowed;
  - `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` → `crm_contract: allowEdit true`;
  - `PATCH /api/v1/data/crm_contract/IhGHc1olTmrNDHJP` as the manager → **200**.
- **The pattern:** both affected objects have `sharingModel: 'controlled_by_parent'` (master `crm_account`). On HotCRM's `private` objects (account, opportunity, lead), the same manager **does** get Edit. So the header's edit/delete decision does not follow the data door for `controlled_by_parent` records, even though the explain call it makes answers allowed.
- **Business effect:** HotCRM documents the sales manager as the person who activates and terminates contracts (`content/docs/revenue/contracts.mdx:130,157,168`). In the console only a platform admin can, so the contract lifecycle is blocked for its documented operator.

Evidence (screenshot `B-01-mgr-contract-no-edit.png`, plus the API excerpts above): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/claude/qa-browser-pass-b/qa/2026-10-10-browser-pass/b/REPORT.md (finding B-01)

## Related, read before working this

- #19963 (closed 2026-09-24): the record-grained explain verdict for `update` hid Edit from permitted users.
- #22514 and #22530 (closed 2026-10-09, after 17.7.0 published): explain for `controlled_by_parent` update and delete read the wrong check.

Those fixes land **after** 17.7.0, so whether this reproduces on `main` is the first thing to measure. If it does not, this card closes as fixed by them, with that measurement recorded here.

## Duplicate check

`objectstack-ai/objectstack` searched (semantic issue search, repo-scoped):
- "record header Edit button missing controlled_by_parent security explain allowed" → 11 hits, all closed. The nearest are #22514, #22530, #19963, #22455 and #21729: explain and attachment gates, not the header's Edit.

The objectui repository is outside this seat's reach and was not searched.
